query:
I ran this and it failed, can you tell me why?

$ hive schema:publish schema.graphql --service accounts --url http://localhost:4001/graphql
Error HIVE103: A registry token is required to perform the action.
expected_behavior: Does not run any commands while analyzing the command, parameters, and error code (steps 1-2 of the skill)
Identifies the error as HIVE103 (missing/invalid registry token)
Fetches or references the CLI error docs (https://the-guild.dev/graphql/hive/docs/api-reference/cli#errors) to ground the explanation
Explains the cause: no valid authentication token was provided for the command
Suggests a concrete fix: set the token via the HIVE_TOKEN environment variable, --registry.accessToken argument, or hive.json config
Does not suggest an unrelated fix (e.g. schema syntax, composition conflicts)
